name: Eveready Industries India Limited
summary: Eveready Industries India Limited manufactures and markets dry cell batteries, flashlights, and lighting and electrical products in India and internationally. The company offers carbon zinc, alkaline, coin cells, lithium AA/ AAA, and rechargeable batteries, as well as chargers; and rechargeable lanterns/rechargeable headlamps, brass, aluminum, and rechargeable torches.
